generally speaking i think im really good at sizing up early late into a trend before it gets euphoric, ive made most of my money this way. pump, zec etc. i am extremely bad at playing the last 20% near the top and holding the middle boring slow part, as are most. 

i want to be in as few middle boring slow trades as possible at all times 

kind of impossible to argue that we’re anywhere else but there right now with coins. euphoric pumps on alts last 90 days. honestly kinda weaker than ideal pump on btc but it still worked. onchain grasping for life then we get the death narrative with the ai justin drake whatever blah blah 

at a baseline whenever we get a flush like we had wednesday/thursday it’s just not possible to V back to ath. look what happened to dram soxl or any other crypto wipeout in the past. it almost can’t happen and has to build a base for a while. then the few people with opinions decide what we think about the assets who wants out etc etc

as it relates to crypto i actually believe in the frank thesis. best bull case is becoming the frontier hub for cryptography again, which the entire world needs more than ever, solving it first as would be tradition with crypto and achieving this “perfect defi/security” idea. hard to not be impressed with the collective response to justin drake and a market unifying common enemy is powerful. it’s the final boss of wall of worry to climb. anything other than death is good

i think we’re (my stream) gonna have a period here to get smart and think about what does that mean, what is possible, what are our goal posts etc

as always i flip on a dime but we are in no mans land rn
